blind.description: A wall-mounted hanging shop sign featuring a dark wrought-iron style wall bracket with decorative scrollwork and a horizontal bar. Hanging from two small metal rings is a wooden silhouette sign shaped like a mortar and pestle, bordered in warm orange-brown with a light green painted graphic of a mortar and pestle on both faces. The surfaces are solid, smooth, and game-ready with clean hand-painted/stylized textures.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal dark bar with end caps and suspension rings, casting a shadow of the hanging mortar-and-pestle sign and wall bracket onto the floor.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet tall and approximately 2 feet wide, roughly one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure.
